about:
Four-In-One Inc. operates manufacturing facilities in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, and San Jose, California. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It presents itself as a manufacturer of fine food products.

The company produces a line of single-serving food items including homemade sauces, salad dressings, ketchup, jams, jellies, and condiments. Manufacturing and packaging take place at its two plants, where quality assurance is integrated into the process and supported by what it describes as state-of-the-art production and packaging machinery along with ongoing personnel training. Facility sizes, headcount, and annual volumes are not specified.

Four-In-One sells exclusively to the wholesale market, working through a network of institutional food brokers and distribution partners. It does not ship to private consumers. Its customer base includes wholesale distributors and foodservice operators who rely on the company's delivery system for pallet and truckload orders.

The company emphasizes its reliable sales and distribution network, efficient delivery system with 24-hour distribution centers, and competitive pricing as key differentiators. It also highlights readily identifiable, easy-to-read packaging as part of its brand promise.
